settings.name: Espadín
settings.nose: Gentle smoke, aloe, honey, green olive
settings.palate: Sichuan pepper, grapefruit peel, star fruit, miso, light smoke, citrus lift
settings.desc_body: This expression captures a classic mezcal profile, balancing smoke, spice, acidity, and subtle sweetness.
settings.pair_cocktails: Mezcal Negroni, Oaxacan Old Fashioned, Paloma
settings.pair_food: Grilled citrus shrimp, queso fresco, charred corn, salsa verde
settings.pair_body: Its balanced smoke and bright acidity make Espadín the most versatile pour in the range.
settings.highlight_1: Single-village production in the highlands of Oaxaca
settings.highlight_3: Small-batch — never more than 600 bottles per run
settings.highlight_4: The ideal introduction to artesanal mezcal
settings.review_quote: “Probably the most complex mezcal I’ve ever tasted. Truly special.”
